source.evidence: ScoreBase/PDMX score 148760 is structurally a complete Benedictus + Hosanna witness, but ingestion proves it contains only six note-bearing tracks: SATB plus two organ staves. That is a vocal/organ reduction, not the full Süssmayr orchestration required by Musicarium's Full Rendition contract.

sourceCandidates.reason: Complete movement, but only SATB + organ reduction (6 note-bearing tracks).

20-track file includes basset horns, bassoon, trumpet, trombones, strings and SATB and is explicitly sequenced by D. Viens (1997), but redistribution/license rights are not established. Do not vendor.
Public-domain and CC-licensed complete scores exist and establish the traditional Süssmayr orchestration; a machine-readable redistribution-clean symbolic transcription is still required.
